intro.text:
Whether you're new to lifting or chasing a new PR, this program builds strength the right way: sound technique, intelligent programming and steady progression. Your coach designs each block around your goals and adjusts as you progress.

Expect to move better, lift more, and build strength that carries over into everything you do.
